info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Expires-v3-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Expiration API enables users to access and monitor the status of loyalty points set to expire. This API serves as a vital tool for customers who wish to manage their hotel loyalty benefits effectively, ensuring they can redeem their points on time. Typical consumers include loyalty program members and hotel booking platforms seeking to provide users with insight into their points. By offering timely information about expiring points, this API enhances user engagement and helps maximize the value of loyalty memberships.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the expiration details for their points. It provides information on when points will expire, helping users plan their use of rewards effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters for expiring points. It should include the details necessary to process the expiration of points associated with a user or account.

200.description: The request was successful and the point expiration details are returned.
